page.layout: One printed page, one text column in the centre with a marginal note at the right margin ("* Martia:" beside the first lines, plus a handwritten mark which is not printed). Running head at top; page number at top right. Left margin holds only show-through and stains.

main_text.p: muto meritò comparandus; bruto potiùs; unde Stultus, Germanis * Thor, quasi Thier, bruta pecus. Qui autem plus solito tacet, in bis dumps, dicitur. * Martia:
Duom, Judicium: & duoma, judicia: & duomot, judicatis] His respondet, sono pariter & sensu, Saxon. dom, nostratium doome, Teuton. doem (nomen) item deman (verbum) Teuton: doemen.

Duomis, Templum] A Latin. Dominicum; & Dominus, de quo pluribus Spelmannus nofter in voce Dominicum; nisi malis à domus, quod templum domus sit per excellentiam, Dei scil. ipsius domus. Hîc etiam vide Kilian. verbo Dom. & Befold. de Nat. Pop. cap. 18. in voce Dome.
main_text.head: Verba:
main_text.p: Dualont, Errant: nunc dolen] Huic affine Sax: dpelian, errare, zeodpylo; error, zeodpola, & zeodpolman; Hæreticus. Conveniunt Belg. dwaelen, & dwaelingbe, de quibus vid. Kilian.
